## Changes

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

List checks run, results, and evidence links.
Identify anything not tested.

## Author checklist

- [ ] Relevant tests and required CI checks pass
- [ ] No private keys, credentials, or sensitive data added
- [ ] Setup and security documentation updated where needed
- [ ] Dependency changes and scanner findings reviewed
- [ ] Exceptions documented with justification and review conditions

## Required reviews

Two different reviewers other than the author must submit reviews.

Correctness reviewer: @
Security reviewer: @

Correctness review covers behavior, tests, and requirements.
Security review covers threats, authorization, input validation,
private keys, sensitive data, and dependency changes.

Each reviewer identifies their role in their submitted review.
